# TotalLossToolkit.com — llms.txt
# https://llmstxt.org/

# Site: TotalLossToolkit.com
# Description: Tools and guides to help vehicle owners navigate total loss insurance claims.
# Owner: TotalLossToolkit

## Key Pages

- /: Homepage — total loss vehicle valuation reports
- /pricing: Purchase a vehicle valuation report
- /knowledge-base: Free educational articles on total loss claims
- /directory: Directory of service providers (public adjusters, attorneys, appraisers)
- /faq: Frequently asked questions
- /guarantee: Money-back guarantee details

## Knowledge Base Articles

Articles are available at /knowledge-base/[slug]. The sitemap at /sitemap.xml lists all published URLs.

## Do Not Index

- /api/*: Internal API routes
- /admin/*: Admin panel
- /dashboard/*: User dashboard
- /reports/*: Private user reports
